verdict.rationale: mParticle's Warehouse Sync API and Platform APIs (Audiences, Consent Filters, Data Privacy Controls) support bulk data ingestion and management across many users/events, which is the closest evidence to bulk operations, but there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk event API, rate limits, or multi-item CRUD operations tailored for programmatic/AI-native bulk use. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoint documentation, batch size limits, and examples of bulk create/update/delete operations across items (e.g., audiences, users, events) in a single call.
